system.description: While that low: action + 40 MP overlays a pocket dimension reflecting your psyche, containing any creatures you choose. A 4-segment Otherworld Clock erases each turn (and on damage with a WLP roll of 3 or lower). Inside, one chosen spell or free-attack Skill automatically succeeds at HR 5, and one Attribute runs a size larger (max d12). The Unmasking, made literal.
